_meta.description: Known conflicting sources. Both values are kept, dated; later info supersedes but never deletes earlier info. Tools must present unresolved entries as contested, never flatly.

s-era2022.note: era-tagged 2022 report (role + date only); predates at least one later potion-system change

1.2x INT

contradictions.resolution: The in-game tooltip (1.2) is adopted as truth for computation; the doc value may be outdated or the shipped value differs from the doc. mechanics const:magicka-mult-atronach = 1.2.

contradictions.subject: ench:one-charge-110
contradictions.topic: Do enchanted items recharge without soul gems?

positions.value: No passive recharge since 0.8; filled soul gems required
Items recharge naturally based on the wearer's Enchant skill (effectively infinite charges at 110)

contradictions.note: Possibly skill-gated recharge vs passive recharge being different things, or a pre/post-0.8 change. One in-game test settles it.

contradictions.subject: formula:hp
contradictions.topic: HP spec ratios (3.6/2.8/2.2) vs dev Lua multipliers (1.14/1.033/1.077)

positions.value: Lua spec multipliers 1.14/1.033/1.077
Effective L60 ratios 3.6/2.8/2.2

contradictions.resolution: Both describe the same system: the Lua multipliers are the spec factor inside it; the effective ratios fold in the remaining layers. Validated exact (Stealth) and within 1 HP (Magic). Combat 3.6 still unvalidated; Magic 2.2-vs-2.19 rounding open.

contradictions.subject: fact:potion-strength-inputs
contradictions.topic: Does Secret Master apparatus affect max potion potency?

positions.value: Max-value potions achievable with a plain Master apparatus set given maxed alchemy perks and skill (Breton)
Current max-potion meta includes the full Secret Master apparatus set

contradictions.subject: formula:magicka
contradictions.topic: Does magicka scale with INT above 175 when the INT cap is raised by Fortification Max?

positions.value: Flat cap: maxMag uses min(INT, 175) regardless of any raised cap
positions.note: One L60 reading matched floor(min(181,175) x 3.7) = 647 exactly — but came from a session with known-unstable pool readings (duplicate ability applications observed the same day).

positions.value: Cap-relative: magicka scales with INT up to the effective cap (175 base + Intelligence Fortification Max); 175 is just the un-raised base

contradictions.resolution: Cap-relative adopted (maintainer ruling 2026-08-24): formula:magicka uses min(INT, INT_cap). The 2026-08-21 flat-cap reading is attributed to that session's unstable pool readings.

contradictions.subject: item:ancient-shrouded-left-glove-left
contradictions.topic: Ancient Shrouded glove AR: 46, 46.5, or a 49-reading normalized?

positions.value: 46 (as-posted wiki tooltip; capture skill unknown)
positions.note: Both wiki tooltip images (left and right glove) read Armor Rating 46.

positions.value: 46.5 (curated skill-100 value carried by the codex and, until v1.21, one builder record pair)
positions.note: Origin of the .5 not reconstructed; possibly a normalization of a non-100-skill capture.

positions.value: 49 (maintainer's own in-game tooltip capture, 2026-08-19; capture Light Armor skill unrecorded)
positions.note: Normalizes to ~46-46.5 if the capturing character's Light Armor was ~106-107; the capturing character's Light Armor value at capture settles this.

contradictions.note: Builder v1.21 carries 46 (dedup kept the wiki-image pair) pending resolution; one Light Armor reading from the capturing character normalizes the 49 and closes this.

contradictions.subject: formula:magicka
contradictions.topic: What is the magicka pool's base multiplier? A clean-character reading contradicts the validated formula.

positions.value: Additive carriers on a x1 base: pool = min(INT, cap) x (1 + racial + sign). Validated exact 2026-08-21 (647 = floor(175 x 3.7) on an Altmer/Atronach at capped INT).
positions.note: The validating character is a vampire main; the maintainer now suspects vamp/WW characters may carry hidden/bugged passives (cf. the separate known single-character magicka/fatigue anomaly already in the KB), so this validation may be contaminated - or only valid at capped INT.

positions.value: Pool much larger than (1+r+s) x INT: a CLEAN L60 Breton/Atronach (naked, zero masteries spent, no vamp/WW, INT 100, WIL 115, active-effects list showing exactly 'Magicka Bonus 0.5x INT' + 'Wombburn 1.2x INT') reads max magicka 469 where the formula predicts 270.
positions.note: Best-fitting hypothesis: a level-scaled base multiplier (~3.0 at L60) giving (3.0+0.5+1.2) x 100 = 470 vs 469 observed (off by one - floor?); but that model gives 997 for the 2026-08-21 reading's character, so the two measurements cannot both fit one simple model. A flat +199 level term fits the clean reading but not the capped one either. The dev-stated Magicka spec factor 1.5 (fact:spec-hp-magicka-factors) fits neither (405).

positions.value: Level-scaled pool: maxMag = floor(INT x (spec_magicka_factor + carriers + ~0.025 x level)) - the dev-stated spec factors (Combat 0.9 / Stealth 1.15 / Magic 1.5) ARE live in the pool, base is NOT 1 x INT.
positions.note: Second clean reading, L1 Combat Redguard/Steed naked (no carriers): 27 = floor(0.9 x 30 + ~0.025x1x30) EXACT - 1 x INT would give 30. Under this model the L60 clean reading predicts 470 vs 469 observed (one short - the same off-by-one as the L60 HP reading, suggesting per-level floor accumulation). The 2026-08-21 validation (647 = 3.7 x 175) still conflicts: under this model that character (Magic spec, Altmer/Atronach, L60) predicts 5.7 x min(INT,cap) = 997 at INT>=175 - but that session had known-unstable readings, and 647/5.7 = 113.5 hints the character's real INT at capture may have been ~113, not 175+. A naked re-read of that character settles it.

contradictions.note: Decisive next tests: (1) Fortify INT item delta on the clean L60 - delta per INT point = the true marginal multiplier (~4.69-4.7 under the level model); (2) one naked MID-level alt reading - pins the ~0.025/level term and the off-by-one behavior; (3) naked re-read of the 2026-08-21 validation character (vamp main) - tests both the contamination suspicion and the INT-113 hypothesis.
